question: For the disputed vehicle ability times of L3354, do EA's notes say which of registry default and own value is current?

sourceFacts.method: The two disputed abilities for which EA's 1.3.1.0 notes state a change were compared: own value against EA's old number and registry default against EA's new number.

control.description: Smoke Screen RechargeTime: own 20, registry 16; EA '20 to 16'. Thermal Smoke ActiveTime: own 7, registry 10; EA 'increased by 3 seconds'.

cases.eaStatement: Reduced the cooldown of the Smoke Screen from 20 to 16 seconds.
Thermal Smoke: increased active duration by 3 seconds.

thermalSmokeRechargeTime.eaStatement: none found for thermal smoke cooldown

inference: In both cases the own value is the number before EA's change and the registry default the number after it. The registry default is therefore the value in use for these abilities, the same pattern as weapon damage (L3327, L3339) and missile speed (L3343).

By the same pattern the other disputed abilities of L3354 would use their registry defaults: tank active protection 5 s active, emergency repair 24 s recharge, thermal smoke 16 s recharge. That extension is an inference.
Thermal smoke's active time is 10 s.
unresolved: Direct check: time the smoke screen cooldown (16 s) and the thermal smoke duration (10 s) in game.
Thermal smoke cooldown: registry 16.0, own 20.0, no EA figure found.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: EA's smoke changes equal registry minus own: for vehicle abilities too the registry default is the current value and the own value the previous one
leads.summary: Two EA statements settle the registry-or-own question for vehicle abilities: the smoke screen's own recharge time is 20 and its registry default 16 (EA: 20 to 16), and thermal smoke's own active time is 7 and its registry default 10 (EA: plus 3 seconds). The registry default is the current value. 6 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: A timed ability in game that matches the own value instead.
leads.statusNote: Two official changes equal registry minus own; extension to other abilities inferred.
